items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Bert Hall. Bert Hall. Bert Hall. Bert Hall. Bert Hall and, well, we had, it had to be a good band because that place was so big.

ctx.x: Do you remember both? Do you remember both? No, what was it, Jim Hall, I think. Jim Hall. Jim Hall.

Jim Hall used to get... Bert Hall. Bert Hall. Bert Hall. Bert Hall. Bert Hall and, well, we had, it had to be a good band because that place was so big. The kids were dancing and happy and making noise. And then we had to play because they had double band nights. A lot of bands coming in and said they didn't want us out. And the microphones wasn't very popular. No. I mean, I don't think we had any microphones at all then. Let's use a horn, a megaphone. Yeah, a megaphone. Well, uh... I used to still bow in with a…
We sure did. We sure did. We sure did.
